th.AMD: AI-infra long with a server-CPU leg; risk concentrated in MI450 execution.
th.PWR: Labor pick-and-shovel on the grid/data-center super-cycle (backlog $48.5B).
th.BLK: iShares/index scale plus private markets (GIP/HPS) and Aladdin/Preqin; above-target organic base-fee growth versus market beta, private-credit liquidity and AI-financing concentration.
th.WMB: Gas-midstream compounder (Transco + Power Innovation); debate = valuation + PI earnings quality.
th.IREN: Ex-miner neocloud that owns its land, power and DCs (~5 GW executed grid agreements, no colo leases); $20.3bn backlog ~2/3 MSFT/NVDA IG, 3 customers = 70% of rev; $4bn ARR slipped to Jan-Mar-27 on a MSFT change order + suppliers; FY27 capex paced to ~$20bn by funding ($6bn gap), not demand; Dec-Q Street ($344m rev / $153m EBITDA) looks too high.
th.CEREBRAS: Wafer-scale fast-inference vs NVDA; OpenAI take-or-pay; UAE concentration. Recent IPO, no public consensus.
th.TLN: PJM merchant IPP (Susquehanna nuclear + AWS PPA); risk = concentration + co-location regulation.
th.ANTHROPIC: Pre-IPO frontier lab (S-1 2026-10-26, Nasdaq: ANT): 2Q26 rev $11.6bn, first op. profit; 85% serving GM (1H26); 48% sold via AWS/GCP/Azure, which are also its compute suppliers and financiers. Q3/IPO terms blank.
th.AMZN: AWS re-acceleration (+28%) + in-house silicon (Trainium); debate = $200B capex/ROIC.
th.OWL: Permanent-capital alternatives manager; real-assets/data-center and institutional growth versus wealth-BDC liquidity, private-credit quality and project-financing risk.
th.NVDA: Full-stack AI-factory platform at +85% rev; debate is demand sustainability vs ASIC erosion.
th.GEV: Cleanest AI-power earnings-revisions story (orders +71%); bear = order peak + Wind.
th.KKR: Asset management, insurance and strategic holdings; fee-base growth versus earnings comparability and balance-sheet exposure.
th.MSFT: AI ARR >$37B/+123%; swing is capex (CY27 ~$276B) vs Azure revenue + OpenAI concentration.
th.GOOG: Full-stack compounder (Search +17%, Cloud +82%); debate is valuation and capital intensity, not demand.
th.GS: Capital-markets and wealth franchise; advisory recovery and durable fees versus trading cyclicality and expenses.
th.NBIS: Highest-octane listed neocloud (ARR→$7-9B, NVDA stake); capex burn + circular-financing scrutiny.
th.BX: Alternative asset-management scale; fee activation and realizations versus private-wealth liquidity and valuation risk.
th.BE: On-site SOFC fuel cells for DC power (Nebius/Google); bull = grid bottleneck, bear = Redburn Sell + Delta/Ceres competition.
th.TSLA: Rotating from EV volume to autonomy/robotics re-rate (FSD, Optimus, Terafab); MS EW $415, JPM just to Neutral.
th.META: Fastest grower in Mag7 ex-GPU; bear = capital intensity and negative incremental ROIC.
th.ORCL: Turned into an AI-infra hyperscaler (RPO $638B/+363%); bear = dot-com-peak capex/sales + dilution.
th.VST: Largest US merchant power turning into an AI-power play; debate is pace, not direction.
th.JPM: Diversified banking scale; debate is sustainable NII and capital-markets earnings versus expenses, credit and capital requirements.
th.SPCX: IPO'd Jun-2026 (~$75bn, largest ever); Starlink + Launch + AI (ex-xAI: Grok/X/COLOSSUS ~1GW, ~325k GPUs). FY25 rev $17.2bn, net loss ~$(4.9)bn; Musk ~82% vote. Read-through to NVDA/CRDO.
th.CRWV: Highest-visibility GPU neocloud ($104B backlog, 1.5 GW active, 8 GW 2030 target) but $35.6B principal at 9-11% + customer concentration; house DCF $59 @10% hinges on rev/GW and GPU replacement.
th.OPENAI: Private frontier lab (ChatGPT/GPT); scale + distribution vs cash burn + sub-50% share; Microsoft-anchored. No public financials.
th.NSCALE: UK GPU neocloud, S-1 filed 2026-09-18 (NYSE: NSCL): $103.4bn TCV / 5.7-yr WAL / 1.37 GW IT ⇒ ~$13bn rev per IT-GW/yr (Anthropic Monarch ~$16bn); Microsoft $43.8bn + Anthropic $44.6bn = 86% of book; Anthropic financing not yet committed. No BBG consensus (pre-IPO).
th.AAPL: Strong franchise + memory-dislocation advantage; bear = AI catch-up + price elasticity.
